STAGE: evidence read.
GOAL: ground each ranking in the frozen bundle before placing any proposal.
READ: all seven bundles (68dcd879..., 28b5638c..., 7e2173f0..., 3e67caf8..., 8381a1fa..., caf10ee0..., 6320f35e...). The observed blocks are largely shared: E6 width-20 beam survival (l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500); E7 teacher-forced NLL; E8 first-level capacity ceiling (K=16 0.3106, 32 0.2164, 64 0.1547, 256 0.0822 share of canonical pairs sharing a cluster); E9 successor/cohort-profile signal (0.9291 vs 0.8871; profile overlap wins for 0.5898 of pairs); E11 same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
OBSERVED: behaviour injected into assignment of existing levels has repeatedly scored BELOW the Euclidean/l1 variants (0.051-0.055 vs 0.062); coarse K should stay small; the deepest level is the measured bottleneck. E6 also shows gold prefix alive at depth 4 only 0.068-0.088 for every arm, so a fourth token is hard for Stage 3.
OPEN: no ablation or run is done; placement is a single-run bet.

STAGE: ranking rationale fixed.
GOAL: order the seven candidates by expected single-run Stage-3 recall, using only the frozen evidence.
READ: proposal specs plus E6/E7/E8/E9/E11.
OBSERVED / REASONING: (1) BCMID-L3-RQ is the only candidate that expands the level the evidence says is starved (1.24 L3 codes per L2 pair) while leaving L1/L2 at 256, uses the E9-validated successor-profile signal (mean-centred), and does not move item points, so it cannot repeat the merge failure. (2) HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ is also 3-token and deep-only with a spacing-capped offset, but its asymmetry buffer can be near zero and one child may go unused. (3) BEHDIR-L4 is the safest additive design (L1-L3 bit-identical, derived s0/K4, no new loss) but E6/E7 price the fourth token: depth-4 survival 0.068-0.088 and the T4 NLL is where generation fails. (4) GYRO-BEHAFF-SID genuinely repairs the near-zero r^3 via gyro-subtraction, but doubling L2 to 512 runs against E8's coarse-K curve and a=1 can zero the geometric term. (5) BISECT-L4-ASYM is additive but its behaviour is a scalar asymmetry weight over ~5-item quartiles, sparse per E5, plus the depth-4 penalty. (6) CGREP-4L-RQ pushes through q_i over all levels (coarse-partition risk), adds a low-survival fourth token, and its +0.7104 behaviour-contrast correlation is not in the bundle. (7) HOLO-TILT-L3 rotates a residual the evidence says is near zero, so the rotation is inert on the stated collapse while adding item-specific noise, and it also doubles L2.
OPEN: final answer text still to be emitted as the last record.

STAGE: final answer.
GOAL: emit the complete ranking, one line per proposal, positions 1..7 with no ties or gaps.
READ: the frozen bundles and the seven specifications.
OBSERVED: ranking decided as BCMID-L3-RQ 1, HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ 2, BEHDIR-L4 3, GYRO-BEHAFF-SID 4, BISECT-L4-ASYM 5, CGREP-4L-RQ 6, HOLO-TILT-L3 7.
ANSWER (also returned as the reply):
RANK: BCMID-L3-RQ | position=1 | reason=...
RANK: HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ | position=2 | reason=...
RANK: BEHDIR-L4 | position=3 | reason=...
RANK: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID | position=4 | reason=...
RANK: BISECT-L4-ASYM | position=5 | reason=...
RANK: CGREP-4L-RQ | position=6 | reason=...
RANK: HOLO-TILT-L3 | position=7 | reason=...
OPEN: none; the full reasoned lines are the task reply.
